notes.exclude: No manuscript source, literature full text, old QCNN/Torch work, yearly checkpoints, pilot, partial/failed predictions, or redundant through-year files selected. All listed dataset/results inputs exist at original project root.
notes.publication_data: Original raw CSV is outside project_root; copy separately with source metadata. Frozen inputs keep original relative paths and original decompressed bytes. Preserve immutable F-drive original.
notes.portability: Scientific ROOT/PROJECT/REV paths need project_config adaptation. Restore frozen inputs to FX_WORK_ROOT before imports. RAW is separately configured. Some imports create output directories or execute diagnostics.
notes.gzip: Compress repository CSVs; prepare_replication restores original .csv bytes. Keep original manifest hashes and record compressed hashes separately. Biggest inputs: scenario_v2/predictions.csv=284954730, internal_full/predictions.csv=118740964, horizons/predictions.csv=128974763 bytes.
notes.styles: Bundled SciencePlots mplstyle files suffice; retain SciencePlots_LICENSE.txt. Arial affects visual fidelity.
notes.tables: jof20_nature_tables.py originally reads two v19 manuscript Markdown sources. Ported script must use 25-table Markdown extract built from selected main_table_*.csv and supporting_table_S*.csv. Full manuscript sources excluded.
notes.visual_manifest: FIGURE_MANIFEST.json original paths/hashes require portable path resolution. Provenance manifests are prior execution evidence, not new numerical runs.
notes.verification: Read-only source inspection and exact file existence/size checks; prior execution manifests document earlier completed runs. No experiment rerun performed by inventory generation.
notes.fastest_validation: Rebuild2018-01-02 and2020-03-17 via joint17_internal_scenarios.prepare(),annual_data(year,16),forecasts_at(). Join each120 rows to stored internal_full by origin/book/report/tau/model/train_reference;compare actual_loss,var,es,score,strict_hit,scenario_n;cash tolerance1e-12,score1e-9. Record simulated errors separately. Then run joint17_analyse in new work and compare model_summary,primary_score_contrasts,calibration.
